notes.title: Update notes for Superspective 0.2.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Superspective 0.2.2[/b] includes:[/p][list][*][p]New playtest message upon game game startup. I'll probably make this a "first time startup only" thing in the future[/p][/*][*][p]Changed [i]A Space Between[/i] level layout to prevent unnecessary and lengthy backtracking to previous area[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a new secret area, somewhere...[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog box when settings menu is exited without applying changes[/p][/*][*][p]UI navigation should feel more fluid and intuitive in general, fixed several issues with dialogs getting stuck onscreen[/p][/*][*][p]Major performance improvements for moving PillarDimensionObjects (e.g. every cube in the game) collisions caching[/p][/*][/list][p]As well as bugfixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed Locus Maximus grow/shrink hallways interacting with objects outside of their specified scale range. This was causing players who were already big to grow potentially infinitely big by running into the hallway in a certain way.[/p][/*][*][p]"Portal wiggling", where the player rapidly crosses over a Portal threshold and back to sneak onto the backside of a Portal, has been fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the annoying bug with autoload causing button prompts to get vomited onto the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several issues in a class of bugs related to static data not getting reset upon game restart/load[/p][/*][*][p]Improved IsVisibleFrom check to handle degenerate geometry cases like 0-width planes[/p][/*][*][p]Cursor visibility and lock state should behave more consistently with alt-tabbing out of the game[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reset default camera shake value from 100 -> 50 (woops)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Finally, this version of Superspective contains a fundamental rewrite of a very foundational aspect of the non-Euclidean physics in the game: raycasting -- and more specifically, raycasting through Portals and with respect to PillarDimensionObjects... as well as Portals which [i]are[/i] PillarDimensionObjects. The end result is that interacting with objects through a Portal plane should feel more much consistent, and there should be less buggy behaviour in general on the threshold of a Portal plane.

Thank you for following development of the game! With this update, the groundwork has been made for adding more puzzle content, especially puzzles which involve multiple non-Euclidean effects in the same scene. I look forward to continuing development and getting some more level design work done soon![/p]

notes.title: Update notes for Superspective 0.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Superspective 0.2.0[/b] includes:
- New level [i]Locus Maximus[/i] added
- Invert Y-axis controls added
- Interactable object glow improvements
- Various performance improvements
- Too many bugfixes to list, some rendering issues, some physics bugs, and some related to save files

What's next:
- Performance improvements followup, especially for Locus Maximus which can get rather frame-y on some machines
- More bugfixes reported by playtesters that I didn't get a chance to get to yet
